How It Works

How points work

points — Experience Points

points is your progression currency. It accumulates as you visit, play, and attend events. It never gets spent — it only grows and levels you up, unlocking permanent perks along the way.

Points

Points are your reward currency. Earn them alongside points and spend them on free coffees, drinks, burgers, event tickets, and D&D sessions at any branch.

Earning Made Easy

How to submit a check

1

Order food or drinks at any Placeholder Café branch

2

Ask for your check and note the check number

3

Go to your profile and tap "Submit a check"

4

Enter the check number, branch, total amount, and upload a photo of your check

5

Optionally split it with friends — everyone earns equally

6

A manager reviews and approves — points land in your account
